name: Damage instance (damage event)
description: A discrete offensive interaction that deducts a unit's current health; every damage event carries one damage type (physical/magic/true), zero or more script tags (BasicAttack, ActiveSpell, AOE, Periodic, Item, Proc, Pet, NonRedirectable, Indirect), and zero or more properties controlling interaction with lifesteal, on-hit events, aggro, immunity and dodges.

name: Physical damage
description: Damage type mitigated by armor; dealt by all unmodified basic attacks and many AD-scaling abilities/item effects. Mitigation is a percentage: raw x 100/(100+armor); armor's effectiveness can be reduced by armor penetration.

name: Magic damage
description: Damage type mitigated by magic resistance; dealt by most AP-scaling abilities and some item effects. Mitigation is a percentage: raw x 100/(100+MR); MR's effectiveness can be reduced by magic penetration.

name: True damage
description: Damage type not reduced by resistances or almost all damage-reduction effects; still respects shields and invulnerability, is blocked by spell shields, and is affected by most damage amplifiers (except jungle-item/Smite/Ignite true damage). Not to be confused with raw damage.

name: Raw damage
description: Engine-level damage class (API 'raw') that ignores shields and is negated only by invulnerability or spell shield; ignores death-protection effects by default. The 'internalraw' variant additionally ignores invulnerability. Used by executes such as Urgot's Fear Beyond Death, Pyke's Death from Below, and the Nexus Obelisk.

name: Basic attack
description: The fundamental zero-resource damage source; engine-level 'basic damage' class (API 'attack') dealt by any unit's basic attack and attack-like abilities. Basic attacks deal physical damage by default, can critically strike, apply attack (on-hit/on-attack) effects, draw minion aggro, and are subject to dodge/block/blind.

name: Attack damage (stat)
description: One of the two main offensive champion stats; determines the unmodified physical damage of basic attacks and serves as a scaling ratio (base/bonus/total AD) for many abilities, items and runes. Stacks additively; AD ratios may be attached to any damage type, not just physical.

name: Ability damage (archetype)
description: Archetypal damage dealt by most abilities (and some empowered basic attacks/items/runes/summoner spells); the pre-requisite for triggering ability (spell) effects. Engine classes spell, spellaoe and spellpersist all count as ability damage; deals generate turret aggression but do not trigger minion Call For Help.

name: Spell effects (ability effects)
description: Effects that trigger when a damage instance qualifies as ability damage (ActiveSpell tag), e.g. Liandry's Torment and Rylai's Crystal Scepter. The basic rule: all damage-dealing abilities excluding attack effects deal ability damage; item/runes/summoner-spell damage can also carry the tag.

name: Critical strike (event)
description: A damage event modified by a percentage above 100% (default critical strike damage 200%); occurs semi-randomly on basic attacks via crit chance, or conditionally on certain abilities/items. Interacts exclusively with crit chance, crit damage and Randuin's Omen's Resilience; basic attacks cannot crit structures (with listed exceptions).

name: Critical strike chance
description: Stat denoting the probability a basic attack critically strikes; stacks additively, caps at 100%, and its probability dynamically updates based on recent crit/non-crit outcomes. Some effects scale with excess crit chance (e.g. Senna's Absolution).

name: Critical strike damage (stat)
description: Multiplier applied to a critically striking damage instance, 200% by default (since v26.01; 175% before v10.23); stacks additively and is modified by items like Infinity Edge and abilities like Yasuo's Way of the Wanderer. Average damage = base x (1 + critChance x (critMod - 1)).

name: On-hit effects
description: Effects applied and/or triggered when a basic attack (or attack-like ability) hits its target; hits do not occur on dodge/block/blind. Abilities may apply on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness (e.g. 25%/50%/75%). Also called 'attack effects' or 'proc damage' in game files.

name: On-attack effects
description: Effects that trigger when a champion completes their basic attack's windup (before the hit lands), e.g. Guinsoo's Rageblade, Runaan's Hurricane, Lethal Tempo. Distinct from on-hit effects which require the attack to actually hit.

name: On-damage effects
description: Effects triggered upon dealing (or receiving) damage, often keyed to the damage subtype: e.g. Blackfire Torch/Liandry's on any damage, Black Cleaver/Executioner's on physical damage, Hexdrinker/Morellonomicon on magic damage. These are the 'damage received' and 'damage dealt' hooks.

name: Damage over time (DoT)
description: Damage dealt over an extended period in individually specified intervals called ticks (e.g. every 1s/0.5s/0.25s/0.125s). Subtypes: target-sourced (refreshable debuff), tether-sourced (removed when tether breaks), location-sourced area DoTs, and unit-sourced area DoTs (auras/directions). Usually classified as persistent damage and carries the Periodic tag.

name: Execute
description: Certain death from an effect, usually conditional on the target being below a specific percent health threshold, or damage that scales with the target's missing health. Executes are dealt as raw damage (ignoring shields) with no damage tags.

name: Area-of-effect damage
description: Damage capable of hitting multiple units, recognized by the AOE tag; engine-level class 'area damage' (API spellaoe). Pets are more resilient to AOE damage; AOE often accompanies the ActiveSpell tag.

name: Proc damage
description: A damage tag for instances applied as secondary effects (mostly automatic on-hit applications); intended to be excluded from interacting with most other effects. Engine-level class 'proc damage' (API 'proc').

name: Script-level damage tags
description: The script-level classification system on damage instances (any instance can carry none or multiple tags): BasicAttack, ActiveSpell, AOE, Periodic, Item, Proc, Pet, NonRedirectable, Indirect. Effects without any tag are 'default damage'; executes are additionally tagged as raw damage.

name: BasicAttack damage tag
description: Tag on the primary damage instance of basic attacks, empowered basic attacks, attack-like spells and automatic attack-like effects (e.g. Runaan's Hurricane); interacts with Warden's Mail and is reduced by Plated Steelcaps, and can trigger Conqueror.

name: ActiveSpell damage tag
description: Tag on damage instances of most abilities and some systemic effects that makes them trigger spell effects, including most empowered basic attacks; often associated with spending mana and/or cooldown.

name: Periodic damage tag
description: Tag for repetitive damage: damage debuffs (DoTs), most non-targeted spells dealing damage repeatedly, and repeat hits of some abilities; periodic damage does not interrupt sleep.

name: Item damage tag
description: Tag recognizing damage as coming from a non-champion source such as an item or summoner spell; lets effects meant for champion abilities (e.g. Tiamat's Cleave, Liandry's Torment) ignore those instances.

name: Pet damage
description: Tag (and engine class 'pet damage', API 'pet') for damage dealt by most pet basic attacks; pet damage may or may not be tagged BasicAttack depending on the pet, affecting interactions like Infernal Dragon Soul, Plated Steelcaps and Conqueror.

name: Damage instance properties
description: Per-instance boolean properties in the game scripts that force behaviors: ApplyLifesteal (100% lifesteal, no AoE penalty), EnableCallForHelp (draws minion aggro), RespectDodge, TriggerOnHitEvents, TriggerDamageEvents, ApplyOmnivamp; legacy names include ApplySpellvamp, ApplyDamageModifier, EnableKill, ApplyCritical, ApplyAttackRatio.

name: Reactive damage
description: Engine-level damage class (API 'reactive') for damage dealt by Thorns-type reflection effects; only Thornmail and Bramble Vest use it, while similar reflection effects (Annie, Rammus) are classified as area damage.

name: Persistent area damage
description: Abilities classified as area damage on the engine level but periodic on the script level: engine-level effects (spell vamp) trigger at reduced healing while script-level effects (Arcane Comet) trigger the DoT cooldown reduction.

name: Damage modifier (amplification/reduction)
description: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.

name: Resistance mitigation
description: Armor and magic resistance reduce incoming physical/magic damage by a percentage (actual = raw x 100/(100 + resistance)); negative resistances amplify damage. The amount actually received is called post-mitigation damage.

name: Penetration and resistance reduction
description: Effects that reduce the target's effective resistances before mitigation: percent penetration applies before flat penetration, results cannot go below 0, and only resistance reduction effects can drive armor/MR negative.

name: Damage-based healing (vamp)
description: Healing derived from a percentage of damage dealt: life steal applies to anything classified as basic damage, spell vamp to ability damage, physical vamp to physical damage, and omnivamp to all damage. ApplyLifesteal forces lifesteal on an instance (100% effectiveness by default, no AoE penalty).

name: Capped damage
description: Abilities scaling with the target's health that have a maximum amount they can deal, mostly against minions/monsters; damage is reduced to the cap before damage reductions are applied, so negative resistances can push post-mitigation damage above the cap.

name: Zero-damage instances
description: Effects that deal 0 damage but still trigger events that occur upon dealing/taking damage (drawing turret aggro, in-combat status), either without applying spell effects (0 proc damage) or while applying them (0 ability damage).

name: Cosmetic critical strike (successfully enhanced damage)
description: Unique impact text (large damage number) shown when an ability deals increased damage by successfully passing a condition (e.g. Karthus' Lay Waste hitting a single target); visually similar to a critical strike but not an actual crit and not tied to crit stats.
